name: Lawrence County, Indiana (United States)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the county bicentennial seal: a navy blue ring reading LAWRENCE COUNTY INDIANA around an anchor and star with the years 1818 and 2018 and the motto "Don't give up the ship!".
history: Lawrence County is a county in southern Indiana. Flags of the World records the flag from a 2021 photograph and notes that it appears to be a bicentennial flag, the seal carrying the years 1818 and 2018.

features.role: county seal in navy blue and white with an anchor and the years 1818 and 2018
